item.title: Eisenkot vows to destroy Hamas within 18 months of becoming PM
item.description: Yashar! chairman Gadi Eisenkot pledges to end Hamas rule in Gaza, dismantle its military wing within 18 months if elected Prime Minister, drawing sharp criticism from Likud and Amcha Yisrael.

item.title: Prime Minister to convene meeting with defense establishment chiefs
item.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu will convene a security meeting this evening with the heads of the defense establishment, including IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir, Mossad Director Roman Gofman, Shin Bet Director David Zini, and Defense Minister Israel Katz.

item.description: The natural constituents of the Religious Zionist party should return home rather than chase the chimera of new politicians and new parties that will promise everything and deliver nothing. Opinion.

item.title: Turkish police raid opposition TV channel, arrest 11
item.description: Turkish police raid Halk TV, the country's most-watched news channel, suspend broadcasts and detain 11 people in a widening crackdown on opposition media.

item.title: Heated on-air clash between Yinon Magal and Gadi Eisenkot
item.description: Magal challenges Eisenkot over his opposition to dismantling the Palestinian Authority, accusing him of paving the way for a Palestinian state by opposing construction in E1.
